## Detailed Service Specifications

### Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/seo/

Search visibility is built from clear pages, fast and accessible experiences, useful content, and consistent business information. Hei Digi helps Tirupati businesses strengthen technical SEO, on-page structure and local search foundations with realistic goals and transparent reporting.

**Included Deliverables:**
- Technical SEO checks for crawlability, indexing, status codes and mobile usability
- Page titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal-link improvements
- Search-intent and keyword mapping for important services
- Local SEO support for location signals and Google Business Profile alignment
- Content recommendations based on real customer questions
- XML sitemap, robots.txt, canonical and structured-data validation
- Search Console setup guidance and measurement plan

**Who this is for:** Local businesses, clinics, schools, hospitality providers, suppliers and service teams that want their important pages to be easier for search engines and customers to understand.

**Important Note:** SEO cannot guarantee a number-one ranking or a specific amount of traffic. Google controls its results, and progress depends on competition, site history, content quality and ongoing work. We do not buy reviews or promise overnight rankings.

### Social Media Marketing
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/social-media-marketing/

A business page that posts at random is easy to scroll past. We plan what you publish, design it, schedule it and review what worked, so your Instagram and Facebook pages look like the same business every week.

**Included Deliverables:**
- A monthly content calendar built around your offers, festivals and seasons
- Designed posts and carousels in your brand colours
- Reel ideas and short-form scripts
- Captions and hashtag sets written for your audience
- Publishing and page upkeep on Instagram and Facebook
- A monthly review of what to repeat and what to drop

**Who this is for:** Clinics, schools, shops, builders and service businesses that have a page but no regular plan, and owners who have no time to manage posting themselves.

**Important Note:** We do not promise follower counts or viral reach. Results depend on your offer, your content and your budget, and we report what your page insights actually show.

### Google Business Profile Management
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/google-business-profile-management/

When someone searches for a clinic, school or shop near them, your Google Business Profile is often the first thing they see. We keep it accurate, complete and active so people can find your hours, services and contact details.

**Included Deliverables:**
- A profile audit covering name, address, hours, phone, categories and services
- Service and category setup that matches what you really offer
- Regular Google posts for offers, events and updates
- Photo and cover guidance
- Review-reply drafts in your tone for you to approve
- Updates whenever your business information changes

**Who this is for:** Businesses with a location or service area that customers search for locally, such as healthcare, education, hospitality and trades. Google's guidelines decide eligibility.

**Important Note:** Google decides local rankings. We improve the quality and completeness of your profile, but we cannot guarantee a position in Search or Maps.

### Meta Ads
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/meta-ads/

Ads work best when the offer, the creative and the audience agree with each other. We plan and run Facebook and Instagram campaigns that send interested people to a form, a call or a WhatsApp chat.

**Included Deliverables:**
- A goal and offer review before any money is spent
- Audience research and targeting setup
- Ad creatives and copy for images, carousels and Reels
- Lead form and WhatsApp enquiry campaigns
- Monitoring and optimisation while ads run
- Plain-language reports with recommendations

**Who this is for:** Businesses that want enquiries, not only likes: hospitals and clinics, schools, builders, suppliers and local services.

**Important Note:** Our service fee and your ad spend are separate. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta from your own ad account. We cannot guarantee leads, sales or a specific return.

### Creative Design
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/creative-design/

Good design makes a message quick to understand. We design the graphics your business uses every week in a consistent look, so customers recognise you before they read your name.

**Included Deliverables:**
- Social media posts and carousels
- Posters, flyers and banners
- Video and YouTube thumbnails
- Campaign and festival creatives
- Presentations
- Size variants for each platform

**Who this is for:** Teams that need steady design work without hiring a full-time designer, and campaigns with a fixed date.

**Important Note:** Share your logo and brand colours if you have them. If not, our branding service can create them first.

### Video Editing & AI Videos
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/video-editing-ai-videos/

Short videos get a message across faster than a static post. We edit the footage you have, build motion graphics, and use AI tools where they help, with a person checking every result.

**Included Deliverables:**
- Instagram Reels and short-form editing
- Promotional and announcement videos
- Captions, titles and motion graphics
- AI-assisted video concepts and scenes
- Scripts and storyboards
- Exports for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and WhatsApp

**Who this is for:** Businesses with footage but no editor, and brands that want fresh visual ideas without a full shoot.

**Important Note:** We label AI-generated visuals where it matters, and we do not use a real person's face or voice without permission.

### Branding
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/branding/

A brand is what customers remember after they close the page. We define how your business looks and sounds, and write it down so every post, poster and profile stays consistent.

**Included Deliverables:**
- Brand discovery and positioning notes
- Logo direction and wordmark options
- Colour palette and typography
- Social media profile and cover design
- Marketing material templates
- A short brand guide for your team and vendors

**Who this is for:** New businesses, rebrands, and established businesses whose materials no longer look like they belong together.

**Important Note:** Branding is a creative process, so we agree scope and revision rounds before we begin.

### Personal Branding
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/personal-branding/

People choose a doctor, consultant or founder they trust. We turn your expertise into steady, useful posts, Reels and profile content so the right people know you before they meet you.

**Included Deliverables:**
- Positioning: who you help and what you want to be known for
- Instagram and LinkedIn profile optimisation
- Content pillars and monthly calendars
- Reel scripts and educational posts
- Personal brand creatives
- Thought-leadership content in your voice

**Who this is for:** Doctors, founders, consultants and creators with expertise worth sharing but little time to plan, write and design content.

**Important Note:** For healthcare professionals we keep content educational and avoid exaggerated claims. Please confirm it meets the advertising rules of your medical council. You approve every post before it goes live.

### Content Strategy
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/services/content-strategy/

Without a plan, content turns into guesswork. We decide what to say, to whom and when, then turn it into a calendar that your team or ours can follow.

**Included Deliverables:**
- Content pillars based on your goals and audience
- Monthly content calendars
- Campaign and festival ideas
- Scripts and storytelling angles
- A balance of educational and promotional content
- A simple monthly review

**Who this is for:** Teams that post but without direction, and businesses preparing a launch or a seasonal campaign.

**Important Note:** A plan only helps if it is followed, so we set a realistic pace for your team.

## Industry Approaches

### Healthcare Marketing
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/industries/healthcare/

Patients and families often look for a clinic's speciality, location, hours and appointment route before they call. Healthcare marketing needs clear information and careful approvals, not exaggerated promises.

**Industry Needs:** We support clinics, hospitals, diagnostic centres and allied health businesses with local SEO, Google Business Profile upkeep, educational social content and personal-brand content for professionals. The medical team remains responsible for clinical accuracy and approvals.

### Education Marketing
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/industries/education/

Families compare schools by location, communication, facilities, programmes and how clearly a school answers questions. Useful education marketing gives parents accurate information and a straightforward path to enquire.

**Industry Needs:** We can plan admissions calendars, campus updates, activity posts, profile maintenance, local search content and lead campaigns. Images of students require approval and appropriate permissions; we avoid claims about results or rankings unless the school supplies evidence.

### Steel & Construction Marketing
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/industries/steel-construction/

Buyers often need to confirm product range, stock, location, delivery area and how to reach the sales team. Marketing should make those answers easy to find before a call.

**Industry Needs:** We help steel traders, ready-mix concrete suppliers and construction businesses present their products clearly through search pages, business profile updates, product posts, short videos and enquiry campaigns. Product specifications and availability must come from the client.

### Hospitality Marketing
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/industries/hospitality/

Guests need clear location, room or service information, current photos and a simple booking route. Hospitality content should set accurate expectations and make the next step easy.

**Industry Needs:** We can support hotel profiles, room and amenity content, location pages, seasonal creatives and paid campaigns. Prices, availability, amenities and booking links must be confirmed by the property before publication.

### Professional Services Marketing
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/industries/professional-services/

A professional's website and profile should quickly explain who they help, what they do and how someone can start a conversation. Trust comes from useful information and consistent communication rather than inflated claims.

**Industry Needs:** We plan service pages, local profile information, educational posts, founder-led content and enquiry flows for consultants, coaches and other local service providers. Any qualifications, outcomes or client testimonials must be true and approved.

## Geographic Coverage

### Tirupati
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/locations/tirupati/

Tirupati businesses serve residents, pilgrims, students, patients and nearby towns. The right marketing mix depends on who you need to reach and what they need to know before contacting you.

### Chittoor
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/locations/chittoor/

Businesses in Chittoor need marketing that reflects their real service area, not a page that swaps one town name for another. We plan the message around the products, services and customers the business actually serves.

### Renigunta
**URL:** https://heidigi.com/locations/renigunta/

Renigunta businesses may serve local residents, travellers or customers moving between nearby towns. Useful marketing starts by stating what the business offers, where it operates and how customers can reach the team.

## Legal & Regulatory Compliance

- **Privacy Policy (https://heidigi.com/privacy/):** Privacy framework compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023).
- **Terms of Service (https://heidigi.com/terms/):** Professional service agreement, scope limitations, and transparent billing.
- **Cookie Policy (https://heidigi.com/cookie-policy/):** Zero third-party trackers before explicit consent.
- **Marketing Disclaimer (https://heidigi.com/disclaimer/):** Explicit disclaimer separating agency fees from advertising spend; no synthetic ranking or follower guarantees.
